verdict.rationale: The only published memory specs come from a community review: 16 GB GDDR7 on a 256-bit bus at 896 GB/s. That is a good gaming upgrade, but a single card with 16 GB cannot hold a 70B-class quantized model, which typically needs well over 30 GB even at 4-bit. NVIDIA's own pages say only that the card can 'run the latest AI models locally' and support Ollama and PyTorch backends; nothing in the evidence documents or demonstrates 70B-class inference on this GPU, so the story is not delivered.
